navidad.temporada.no: It's not Christmas season yet (December 1 to January 6).
navidad.regalo.ayuda: Right-click to open it: what will you get?
navidad.pinata.ayuda: Right-click a ceiling to hang it (or the floor). Hit it until it breaks: best with the stick and blindfolded!
navidad.pinata.casi: Hit it, hit it! Almost there...
navidad.venda.ayuda: Right-click: covers your eyes and makes you a bit dizzy (just like at a posada).
navidad.caja.ayuda: Place it and right-click it with what you want to give. Use a name tag: only that person can open it.
navidad.caja.vacia: The box is empty: click it with what you want to give.
navidad.caja.envuelta: 🎁 Gift wrapped! Anyone can open it now... or set "To" with a name tag.
navidad.caja.no_es_tuyo: This gift is for %s (from %s). No peeking!
navidad.calendario.espera: The little doors open from December 1. %s days to go.
navidad.calendario.ya: You already opened door %s. Come back tomorrow!
navidad.calendario.feliz: 🎄 Merry Christmas! You opened %s of 24 doors.
navidad.calendario.fingido: Pretend December day: %s (0 = the real one)
navidad.ropa.ayuda: Right-click to put it on or take it off (shows over your skin).
item.navidad.disco_navidad.desc: We Wish You a Merry Christmas - music box
navidad.adornos.ayuda: In a stonecutter it turns into any Christmas decoration.
navidad.campana.ayuda: Ring it at night... if you dare. It summons the Krampus.
navidad.campana.dia: The bell rings, but nobody answers during the day...
navidad.krampus.llega: Chains rattle in the dark... the Krampus has come for the naughty ones.
navidad.krampus.fase2_sub: If he bags you, mash jump... or have your friends hit him from behind
navidad.krampus.vencido: The Krampus is defeated! Christmas is saved!
navidad.reno.amigo: 🦌 The reindeer is your friend now! Right-click with an empty hand to ride it.
navidad.reno.timido: The reindeer is shy... give it some carrots first.
navidad.jengibre.burla2: 🍪 "I'm made of ginger and I'm faster than you!"
navidad.jengibre.burla3: 🍪 "Not even Mrs. Claus could catch me!"
npc.navidad.santa.hola1: Ho, ho, ho! Have you been good this year?
npc.navidad.santa.hola2: The elves work day and night. Will you lend a hand?
npc.navidad.santa.hola3: They say the Krampus is on the loose... be careful at night.
npc.navidad.senora_claus.hola1: Come in, the cookies just came out of the oven!
npc.navidad.senora_claus.hola2: A nice hot chocolate for the cold, right?
npc.navidad.senora_claus.hola3: If you see a gingerbread man running... he escaped again.
npc.navidad.duende_juguetero.hola1: We take candy here! The best toys at the North Pole.
npc.navidad.duende_juguetero.hola2: A piñata? I have seven-pointed ones!
npc.navidad.duende_juguetero.hola3: Bring me snowballs and I'll pay you in candy.
npc.navidad.duende_sastre.hola1: An ugly Christmas sweater for every occasion!
npc.navidad.duende_sastre.hola2: I make Santa's suit, did you know?
npc.navidad.duende_sastre.hola3: I need red and white wool. Lots of it!
npc.navidad.duende_renos.hola1: Reindeer love carrots. Give them three and they'll be your friends!
npc.navidad.duende_renos.hola2: At night, at Christmas, reindeer almost fly...
npc.navidad.duende_renos.hola3: Have you seen Lightning? He wandered off again.
mision.navidad.galletas_leche.desc: Oh, the journey is long... could you bring me gingerbread cookies and some milk?
mision.navidad.munecos.desc: Some snowmen turned evil and throw snowballs at everyone. Stop them!
mision.navidad.jengibre.desc: Three gingerbread men escaped from Mrs. Claus's kitchen. They're really fast!
mision.navidad.pinata.desc: A posada isn't complete without a piñata. Break one with your friends.
mision.navidad.regalos.desc: Christmas is about sharing: wrap gifts in boxes and have your friends open them.
mision.navidad.krampus.desc: The Krampus wants to ruin Christmas. If you face him, bring your friends... and come prepared.
mision.navidad.carta.desc: I get so many letters that I run out of paper. Could you bring paper and a feather?
mision.navidad.ingredientes.desc: I need sugar and cocoa for the hot chocolate. Can you help?
mision.navidad.pavo.desc: Christmas Eve dinner doesn't cook itself. Bring me cooked chicken and I'll give you turkey.
mision.navidad.horno.desc: I bake cookies every day. Bring me wheat and you get some.
mision.navidad.nieve.desc: We elves are having a snowball fight! Get us some snowballs.
mision.navidad.juguetes.desc: I ran out of wood and red paint. No toys without them!
mision.navidad.lana.desc: Santa's suit wears out every year. Bring me red and white wool.
mision.navidad.zanahorias.desc: The reindeer are hungry after flight practice.
mision.navidad.amigo_reno.desc: Make friends with a reindeer: give it carrots until it loves you.
navidad.aldea.lista: 🎄 Santa's village is ready! (%s blocks in %s ms)
navidad.rosca.muneco: 👶 %s found the baby figurine! Now they have to buy the tamales on February 2nd.
navidad.rosca.nada: Mmm... no baby figurine this time.
navidad.bengala.ayuda: Right-click to light it. Sparks in your hand!
navidad.fiesta.nochebuena: 🌟 It's Christmas Eve! Tonight Santa's sleigh will fly by several times...
navidad.fiesta.navidad: 🎄 Merry Christmas! Santa left a gift in your inventory.
navidad.fiesta.reyes: 👑 Happy Three Kings' Day! You got a rosca... will you find the baby figurine?
navidad.fiesta.trineo: 🛷 Sleigh bells! Look at the sky: it's Santa's sleigh!
navidad.fiesta.posada: 🪅 %s started a posada! Time to break the piñata!
navidad.fiesta.intercambio: 🎁 Gift exchange: you're giving a gift to %s. It's a secret, don't tell!
navidad.fiesta.intercambio_pocos: The gift exchange needs at least two players online.
navidad.fiesta.intercambio_listo: Gift exchange drawn among %s players (everyone got a secret message).
navidad.trineo_madera.ayuda: Put it on snow, hop on and slide downhill. Two can ride.
navidad.trineo_madera.ayuda2: A/D steer · W push · S brake · Shift get off. Slides even more on ice.
navidad.patines.ayuda: Much faster on ice; clumsy everywhere else.
navidad.uvas.ayuda: On New Year's, eat one with each bell toll and make a wish.
navidad.anio.prepara: 🍇 It's almost New Year! Get your 12 grapes ready: one per bell toll.
navidad.anio.doce: 🍇 You ate all 12 grapes in time! Your 12 wishes will come true (and you are very lucky for a while).
navidad.anio.algunas: 🍇 You ate %s grapes. Some luck for you!
navidad.anio.ninguna: You didn't eat any grapes... next year!
navidad.anio.nochevieja: 🍇 It's New Year's Eve! Here are your 12 grapes for midnight.
navidad.buzon.como: Write your letter to Santa in a book and quill and click the mailbox with it.
navidad.carta.vacaciones: Santa reads letters from December 1 to January 6.
navidad.carta.pendiente: Santa hasn't answered your other letter yet. Be patient!
navidad.carta.hoy: You already sent today's letter. Santa reads one a day per person.
navidad.carta.vacia: The letter is empty... write what you would like.
navidad.carta.enviada: ✉ Your letter flew off to the North Pole. Santa will read it tonight... be good!
navidad.carta.llego: 🎅 Santa's answer arrived! Check your inventory.
navidad.carta.llego_malo: 🎅 Santa's answer arrived... it feels heavy, like coal.
navidad.carta.resp.leida: I read your letter by the fireplace with a hot chocolate. My elves worked all night.
navidad.carta.resp.nada: I read your letter, but I couldn't quite tell what you wanted... so here's a surprise.
navidad.carta.resp.malo: I heard you hurt someone you shouldn't have. This year you get coal. There's still time to be good!
navidad.carta.resp.dificil: What you asked for is hard even for my elves, but here is something to make up for it.
navidad.carta.resp.bonito: Some wishes don't fit in a box. Those you take care of, with the people you love.
navidad.carrera.llega: 🛷 You reached the bottom in %s seconds!
navidad.muerdago: 🌿 %s and %s are under the mistletoe! Christmas hug 🤗
navidad.calcetin.lleno: ★ Santa left something in the stocking!
navidad.calcetin.vacio: The stocking is empty... Santa fills it again at night.
navidad.calcetin.carbon: Only coal... someone hurt who they shouldn't have.
navidad.calcetin.fuera: Out of season, stockings are just decoration.
navidad.calcetin.ayuda: In season, Santa fills it every night: right-click to take today's treats.
navidad.galletas.puestas: ★ You left cookies and milk for Santa. He'll come by tonight...
navidad.galletas.ya: Santa already has your cookies for tonight.
navidad.galletas.comidas: ★ Santa ate your cookies and left you a gift next to the plate!
navidad.deco.bebida_espera: Wait a little for another sip.
advancement.navidad.raiz.desc: The most wonderful time of the year is here!
advancement.navidad.carta.desc: Put a letter in Santa's mailbox
advancement.navidad.calcetin.desc: Take what Santa left in a Christmas stocking
advancement.navidad.galletas.desc: Leave cookies and milk for Santa and let him eat them
advancement.navidad.pinata.desc: Break a piñata at a posada
advancement.navidad.rosca.desc: Find the baby figurine in the rosca de Reyes
advancement.navidad.uvas.desc: Eat all 12 grapes in time with the New Year's bells
advancement.navidad.angel.desc: Crouch on the snow looking at the sky until you make a snow angel
advancement.navidad.muerdago.desc: Get a Christmas hug under the mistletoe
advancement.navidad.patines.desc: Skate on ice wearing ice skates
advancement.navidad.colina.desc: Ride down the village sled hill with the clock running
advancement.navidad.reno.desc: Befriend a reindeer by feeding it
advancement.navidad.nacimiento.desc: Place the manger with the Child in your nativity scene
advancement.navidad.casita.desc: Find an elf cottage in the snow and open its chest
navidad.galletas.manana: Santa already came for your cookies. Leave him more next night.
navidad.santa.feliz: Merry Christmas, %s! Here come some gifts...
navidad.regalo_cielo.aterrizo: ★ A gift from Santa landed near you!
navidad.regalo_cielo.atrapado: ★ You caught a gift in mid-air!
advancement.navidad.regalo_cielo.desc: Get (or catch mid-air) a gift Santa dropped from his sleigh
navidad.pinguino.tuyo: ★ The penguin is yours now! Look at its scarf and hat.
navidad.pinguino.sienta: Your penguin will stay sitting here.
navidad.pinguino.pesco: ★ Your penguin caught something and brought it to you: %s!
advancement.navidad.pinguino.desc: Befriend a penguin by feeding it fish
navidad.arbol.tuyo: ★ This is your Christmas tree! Every morning Santa will leave gifts under it. The more decorated, the better the gifts.
navidad.arbol.adornos: Your tree has %s decorations around it  %s
navidad.arbol.regalos: ★ Santa came by your tree and left you %s gifts!
navidad.arbol.carbon: Santa came by your tree... and left you coal. Someone hurt who they shouldn't have.
navidad.arbol.lleno: Santa saw you haven't opened the gifts under your tree: no new ones today.
navidad.ladron.llega: Something is moving near your Christmas tree...
navidad.ladron.robo: The thieving elf stole a gift from your tree! Catch him!
navidad.ladron.atrapado: ★ You caught the thieving elf! He dropped your gift and left some candy to say sorry.
navidad.ladron.atrapado_nada: ★ You caught the thieving elf before he stole anything!
navidad.ladron.escapo: The thieving elf got away with your gift...
advancement.navidad.arbol.desc: Place your Christmas tree and find the gifts Santa left in the morning
advancement.navidad.ladron.desc: Catch the thieving elf trying to steal a gift from your tree
npc.navidad.pinero: Mr. Fir, the Christmas tree seller
npc.navidad.pinero.hola1: Come on in! Fresh trees, just cut from the forest.
npc.navidad.pinero.hola2: A well-decorated tree makes Santa bring better gifts, did you know?
npc.navidad.pinero.hola3: Bring me spruce logs and I will save you the best pine.
mision.navidad.troncos.desc: I ran out of stands for the pines. Bring me spruce logs.
mision.navidad.retonos.desc: For every pine I cut, I plant another. Help me with spruce saplings.
mision.navidad.adornar.desc: Place your tree, decorate it well and wait for Santa to leave gifts under it.
mision.navidad.chocolate.desc: It's very cold out here. Can you get me cocoa beans for hot chocolate?
npc.navidad.duende_viajero.hola1: Hello, hello! I come from far away with my reindeer Comet. Look what I brought.
npc.navidad.duende_viajero.hola2: Tomorrow I'm off to another town... don't miss out!
npc.navidad.duende_viajero.hola3: Comet doesn't bite. Well, sometimes carrots.
navidad.viajero.llega: ♪ Jingle bells nearby... Ramiro, the traveling elf, arrived with his reindeer! He sells things you can't find anywhere else.
navidad.viajero.se_va: The traveling elf and his reindeer left for another town.
advancement.navidad.puesto.desc: Find a Christmas tree lot and say hi to Mr. Fir
advancement.navidad.viajero.desc: Meet Ramiro, the traveling elf, and his reindeer Comet
navidad.renito.tuyo: ★ The baby reindeer is yours now! Its nose will light your nights.
navidad.renito.sienta: Your baby reindeer will stay sitting here.
navidad.renito.sigue: Your baby reindeer follows you again.
advancement.navidad.renito.desc: Befriend a red-nosed baby reindeer (with carrots, or a golden carrot)
navidad.bienvenida.1: • Place your Christmas pine and hang ornaments on it: the prettier it is, the better the gifts Santa leaves every morning. Your Christmas Book tells you what to do.
navidad.bienvenida.2: • Santa flies by once a day and drops gifts with parachutes. Catch them!
navidad.bienvenida.3: • In the snow there are penguins and red-nosed baby reindeer you can befriend (with fish and with carrots).
navidad.bienvenida.4: • Look for Christmas tree lots and the traveling elf: they sell Christmas things for emeralds.
navidad.pino.ayuda: Place it at home and hang ornaments with right click. Sneak with an empty hand to take one off.
navidad.pino.trae: Has %s ornaments, %s light strings and %s garlands.
navidad.pino.sin_lugar: No more room for hanging ornaments on this tree.
navidad.pino.luces_llenas: Your tree already has all three light strings.
navidad.pino.guirnaldas_llenas: Your tree already has all three garlands.
navidad.adorno.ayuda: Right click your Christmas pine: it hangs on the branch closest to where you click.
navidad.adorno.ayuda_luces: Right click your Christmas pine to wrap the lights around it (up to 3 strings).
navidad.adorno.ayuda_guirnalda: Right click your Christmas pine to drape the garland (up to 3).
navidad.adorno.ayuda_punta: Right click your Christmas pine: it goes on the top (it shines and spins).
navidad.libro.ayuda: Right click to open it: Christmas tasks that give you ornaments for your tree.
navidad.libro.sin_arbol: You haven't placed your Christmas pine yet. Put it in your house and hang ornaments on it: the prettier it is, the better the gifts Santa leaves every morning.
navidad.libro.consejo: Each different ornament adds 1 more, and Christmas decorations in your home (near the tree) add up to 25.
navidad.libro.cap.0.texto: Dear friend: Christmas begins at home. Place your pine, hang ornaments and fill your house with lights. Santa will notice.
navidad.libro.cap.1.texto: Go out into the snow: penguins and little reindeer want friends, fish wait under the ice and the snow is for playing.
navidad.libro.cap.2.texto: Santa is already in the sky. Catch his gifts, write to him, leave him cookies... and watch out for naughty elves.
navidad.libro.cap.3.texto: The hardest part: a spectacular tree, Krampus and the evil snowmen. The reward: the crystal north star.
navidad.libro.como.poner_arbol: Craft one (spruce sapling, leaves and log) or buy it from Don Abeto.
navidad.libro.como.colgar: Right click your pine with an ornament.
navidad.libro.como.troncos: Spruces grow in taigas and snowy places.
navidad.libro.como.abeto: His tree lot appears in plains, forests and taigas.
navidad.libro.como.pinguino: Feed raw fish to one in the snow.
navidad.libro.como.golem: Two snow blocks with a pumpkin on top.
navidad.libro.como.pescar: With a fishing rod, in any water.
navidad.libro.como.angel: Lie in the snow: sneak still on it for a moment.
navidad.libro.como.bolas: By hand or with the snow blaster.
navidad.libro.como.renito: With carrots (a golden one never fails).
navidad.libro.como.regalo_aire: Hit one of Santa's gifts before it lands.
navidad.libro.como.abrir: Gift boxes: from Santa, from your tree, from letters...
navidad.libro.como.galletas: Leave them near your tree before sleeping.
navidad.libro.como.carta: Drop a letter in Santa's mailbox.
navidad.libro.como.calcetin: Hang a stocking on a wall and sleep.
navidad.libro.como.ladron: Some nights he comes to steal gifts from your tree.
navidad.libro.como.variedad: Hang 12 different ornaments on your tree.
navidad.libro.como.munecos: They come out at night in the snow.
navidad.libro.como.viajero: The traveling elf arrives every two or three days with his reindeer.
navidad.libro.como.krampus: Summon him with his bell or at the altar of his lair... if you dare.
navidad.libro.te_llega: ★ Santa sent you your Christmas Book: open it (right click) to see your tasks and how your tree is doing.
navidad.lanzanieves.ayuda1: Hold right click: the barrels spin up and fire in bursts.
navidad.lanzanieves.ayuda2: With the tank on, aim at snow to vacuum it and refill.
navidad.lanzanieves.ayuda3: Sneaking: charge a giant snowball (8 shots) and release to launch it.
navidad.lanzanieves.sin_nieve: Out of snow! Wear the snow tank or carry snowballs.
navidad.lanzanieves.tanque_vacio: Your tank is empty! Vacuum snow or fill it (K key).
navidad.lanzanieves.falta_gigante: Not enough snow: the giant snowball needs %s.
navidad.tanque.ayuda: Right click: wear it on your back. Sneaking: open its slots (snowballs or snow blocks).
navidad.tanque.no_traes: You're not wearing the snow tank.
navidad.cascanueces.ayuda1: Right click the ground: he stands guard there (next to your tree, for example).
navidad.cascanueces.ayuda2: At night he patrols, fights off monsters and catches the thief elf.
navidad.cascanueces.ordenes: At your service! (sneak and click to pick him up)
navidad.cascanueces.de_otro: This nutcracker guards someone else's home.
navidad.cascanueces.cayo: Your nutcracker was knocked down! Pick up his figure and place him again.
navidad.cascanueces.atrapo: ★ Your nutcracker caught the thief elf and got the gift back!
navidad.reinicio.libro: Your Christmas Book started over: every task from scratch.
navidad.reinicio.santa: Santa will fly by again today: go outside. Your stockings fill up again and you can send another letter.
navidad.regalo.ahora_caja: Gifts are boxes now: this turns into a wrapped gift box.
navidad.caja_musica.ayuda: Right-click: plays a carol (click again: the next one). Sneak: close it.
navidad.cancion.1: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
navidad.krampus.fase3_sub: In the dark you can't hurt him: light the lanterns
navidad.krampus.robados: His sack burst: %s gifts stolen by his imps fell out.
navidad.krampus.se_fue: The Krampus left laughing in the smoke... he will come back for the naughty ones.
navidad.krampus.luz: The light burns him! Now you can hurt him.
navidad.krampus.deslumbrado: You dazzled him with the lantern!
navidad.krampus.apago_farol: The Krampus blew out a lantern...
navidad.krampus.saco.titulo: He put you in his sack!
navidad.krampus.saco.sub: Mash the jump key to get out
navidad.krampus.saco.otros: The Krampus put %s in his sack! Hit the sack from behind to get them out.
navidad.krampus.saco.forcejea: Struggling: %s of %s (he throws you out in %s s)
navidad.krampus.saco.roto: The Krampus's sack ripped! Gifts fell out.
navidad.krampus.saco.hud3: He throws you out in %s s
navidad.krampusillo.robo: A Krampus imp stole a gift from your tree! Catch it before it gets away.
navidad.krampusillo.atrapado: Caught it! It dropped the gift.
navidad.krampusillo.escapo: The imp got away with the gift... now it's in the Krampus's sack.
navidad.noche_krampus.empieza: Chains rattle in the distance... and bells that don't sound like Christmas.
navidad.noche_krampus.sobreviviste: You survived the Night of the Krampus.
navidad.noche_krampus.no_dormir: You can't sleep: the Krampus is near...
navidad.noche_krampus.comando: The Night of the Krampus started for %s player(s)
navidad.noche_krampus.visitas_si: The Krampus may visit on nights during the season.
navidad.noche_krampus.visitas_no: The Krampus no longer visits (only if summoned).
navidad.altar.ayuda: The altar wants the Krampus bell or %s coal... and it must be night.
navidad.altar.dia: The altar is cold. It only answers at night.
item.navidad.cadena_krampus.ayuda: Right-click: throw the hook. Pulls mobs; on blocks or bosses, it pulls you.
item.navidad.vara_abedul.ayuda: Fast. Every third hit in a row on the same target: a lash!
item.navidad.mascara_krampus.ayuda: On your head: imps won't attack you and the blackout won't blind you.
item.navidad.saco_krampus.ayuda: Burlap backpack: right-click to open it (%s of %s slots used).
item.navidad.campanita_santa.ayuda: Ring it near the Krampus to reveal and stun him; it scares imps away.
advancement.navidad.saco.desc: Struggle your way out of the Krampus's sack
advancement.navidad.saco_roto.desc: Rip the Krampus's sack by hitting him from behind
advancement.navidad.noche_krampus.desc: Survive a visit from the Krampus
advancement.navidad.guarida.desc: Find the Krampus's lair and open its chest
